## What's new

- Ports: MENU > Get PortMaster, then browse PortMaster's catalog on the Brick. May Run on ChaOS lists the ports the Brick can run; each shows its screenshot, needs and description. A installs; its runtime and any library it needs come with it.
- Ports: power pauses a port and asks Resume, Close Port or Power Off. Select+Start quits at once. X on a port removes it, keeping its saves if you like.
- RomM: MENU > RomM signs in to your own RomM server, downloads games onto their shelves with covers, syncs saves and fetches BIOS files.
- Menus say what their rows do, and Appearance chooses which shelves show.
- Fancy Pants draws Muse, Ports and Recently Played in 3D.
- About ChaOS shows the card's free space.
- This update replaces the whole system (it adds what ports need), so it is a larger download than usual. Your games, saves and settings stay.

---

ChaOS 2.0.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v2.0.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v2.0.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
